title: Ordinary compatibility of canonical QCoh rectangle comparisons
statement:
In the canonical qcqs rectangle setting, using the QCoh restrictions [lem-sc-duality-base-change-inverse-square-mate], pinned pullback composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and pinned adjunctions [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], for comparison isomorphisms p and b satisfying the component formulas of [lem-sc-rectangle-qcoh-comparison-lifts] and fixed s with the prescribed ambient component formula, the outer ordinary base-change component followed by p.inv and Q(s.hom) equals b.hom followed by the horizontally composed ordinary maps, without invertibility assumptions on any ordinary map. The complete quantified formula is:
theorem rectangle_qcoh_ordinary_compatibility
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : S ⟶ Y) (h : T ⟶ S)
    (k : pullback (pullback.snd f g) h ⟶ pullback f (h ≫ g))
    (hk₁ : k ≫ pullback.fst f (h ≫ g) =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hk₂ : k ≫ pullback.snd f (h ≫ g) = pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) :
    let U := qcPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))
    let L := qcPullback k
    let V := qcPullback (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
      qcPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let P := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))) _ _
      (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))
    let Q := @qcDirectImage _ _ _ _
      (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)) _ _
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
    let B := qcPullback (h ≫ g)
    let H := qcPullback g ⋙ qcPullback h
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (r : A ⟶ B) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction r
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) r)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) r)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) r))
    let d := conjugateIsoEquiv (a (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h))
      ((a (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))).comp (a k))
      (c k (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun r ↦ derivedPullback.{u, w} r) hk₂))
    ∀ (s : U ⋙ L ≅ V) (hL : L.IsEquivalence) (hs : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (pullback.snd f g) h)).ι.map (s.hom.app E) =
        (let comp := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
         (comp k (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g))).hom.app E.obj ≫
           eqToHom (congrArg (fun v ↦ (derivedPullback v).obj E.obj) hk₁) ≫
           (comp (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
             (pullback.fst f g)).inv.app E.obj)),
    ∀ (p : L ⋙ Q ≅ P) (b : B ≅ H),
      (∀ D : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f (h ≫ g)),
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).ι.map (p.inv.app D) =
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g))).map
            ((a k).unit.app D.obj) ≫ d.inv.app ((derivedPullback k).obj D.obj)) →
      (∀ D : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty T).ι.map (b.hom.app D) = (c h g).inv.app D.obj) →
      ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
        (qcBaseChange f (h ≫ g)).app E ≫ p.inv.app (U.obj E) ≫ Q.map (s.hom.app E) =
          b.hom.app ((qcDirectImage f).obj E) ≫
            (qcPullback h).map ((qcBaseChange f g).app E) ≫
            (@qcBaseChange _ (pullback f g) S T _
              (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
              (pullback.snd f g) _ _ h).app ((qcPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj E)

proof.text: Apply the faithful QCoh inclusion to the desired equality. Use the supplied component formulas for p.inv and b.hom, and the formula hs for s.hom. The definitions of qcBaseChange and the restricted functor maps give the corresponding equality of ambient derived morphisms.

Apply schemeDerivedBaseChange_pasting to the outer square precomposed with k. The proved private helper upper_pasting_transport takes the comparison and adjunction families explicitly, eliminates hk₁ and hk₂ in a generalized square, and reduces the equation to the supplied upper-pasting law. Its proved private cancellation helper commutes the inverse conjugate comparison past the functor map by naturality, then cancels the comparison hom/inv and the upper pullback hom/inv. Postcompose with direct image of the inverse inner upper comparison. By functoriality and associativity, this gives exactly the ambient left side as the base-change map of the pulled-back rectangle followed by that inverse comparison.

Apply schemeDerivedBaseChange_horizontal_pasting to the two canonical pullback squares. Precompose its equality with the inverse bottom comparison c(h,g), cancelling its hom component. The resulting equality identifies the rectangle map followed by direct image of the inverse inner upper comparison with the ambient right side. Compose with the preceding equality and reflect through the faithful inclusion. No ordinary base-change map is inverted, and the calculation applies equally to empty schemes, identity arrows, and zero objects.
